title: Mysterious Dungeon Ruins
description: A side-view 2D dungeon map rendered in a detailed cartoon style, featuring stone platforms, wooden bridges, purple glowing crystals, chains, swinging spiked traps, and a lower chamber filled with toxic green liquid containing bones. The environment includes arched doorways, hanging lanterns, grandfather clocks embedded in walls, and various mechanical and magical elements connected by glowing blue lines.
